description: Recent SEC Form D filings: companies that just raised or are raising private capital, with offering size, amount sold, investors count, industry, state and the SEC filing link. Use for startup funding leads and deal sourcing. Official EDGAR data, issuer-level only. Max 10 rows per call; window up to 14 days.

days.description: Filed in the last N days (default 5).

include_funds.description: Include pooled investment funds (excluded by default).

max_offering_usd.description: Maximum total offering amount in USD.

min_offering_usd.description: Minimum total offering amount in USD.

young_only.description: Only companies incorporated within five years.

name: find_funding_leads
title: Find companies raising private capital (SEC Form D)
